description: Full-text search over the FrontMCP docs, by section: page titles, section headings and prose. Returns up to `limit` sections, best first, each with its page, heading, path (with the #anchor) and the start of its text. Read one with get_page. For an API, option or error code by name, lookup_api is more precise.

query.description: Words to look for, like "rate limit", "deploy to cloudflare" or "elicit".

section.description: Only this part of the docs. Choose blog explicitly for dated articles.

version.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: search_docs
title: Search the docs
